Offerte di lavoro Montatore/Montatrice di sistemi di refrigerazione per il montaggio Montatore/Montatrice di sistemi di refrigerazione per il montaggio dall'80 al 100%, Svizzera orientale Siamo un'azienda innovativa nel settore della tecnica del freddo e dell'energia. Con sede principale a Landquart e circa 80 collaboratori, siamo attivi nelle regioni della Svizzera orientale, Zurigo e nel Principato del Liechtenstein. Facciamo parte del Burkhalter Gruppe, un fornitore leader di tecnologia degli edifici multidisciplinare in Svizzera e nel Principato del Liechtenstein. Per rafforzare il nostro team a Landquart cerchiamo con effetto immediato o da concordare un/una montatore/montatrice di sistemi di refrigerazione per il montaggio (80-100%)

Vacancies Refrigeration System Fitter for Assembly Refrigeration System Fitter for Assembly 80 to 100%, Eastern Switzerland We are an innovative company in the field of refrigeration and energy technology. Headquartered in Landquart and with around 80 employees, we are active in the regions of Eastern Switzerland, Zurich and the Principality of Liechtenstein. We are part of the Burkhalter Group, a leading provider of cross-trade building technology in Switzerland and the Principality of Liechtenstein. To join our team in Landquart, we are looking for a Refrigeration System Fitter for Installation (80-100%) with immediate effect or by arrangement
• Your tasks Installation of refrigeration and air conditioning systems Area of application: Eastern Switzerland
• Your profile Completed training as a Refrigeration System Fitter EFZ or Refrigeration Installation Technician EBA Alternatively: Completed training in the installation sector Manual skills and flexibility Responsible action Driving license Cat. B Our offer Top-equipped company vehicle incl. private use Interesting work in various sectors Development opportunities and active promotion Retraining from other / construction professions Open and respectful working culture Attractive employment conditions A profession with a future Contact Have we sparked your interest? Then apply using the online form below or by e-mail to jobs@kaelte3000.com. If you have any questions, please contact Gaudenz Egger on +41 81 3000 318. Kälte 3000 AG Gaudenz Egger Luxwiesenstrasse 4 7302 Landquart More information about us: www.kaelte3000.com
